execution_policy: Executable Rust unit tests; synthetic Ed25519 keys only; no production trust roots or credentials.

cases.scenario: Canonical active root has a public key matching its SHA-256 fingerprint and is present in the signed trust snapshot with live non-revoked status.
cases.expected: verified=true and trust_decision=trusted with reproducible evidence.

cases.scenario: Declared key fingerprint differs from the decoded Ed25519 public key.
Algorithm is not EdDSA or the algorithm policy version does not match the active policy.
Root is revoked or suspended, activation epoch is in the future, or live key revocation is unavailable.
cases.expected: Never return verified=true; revoked state takes precedence and unavailable revocation fails closed.

cases.scenario: Root ID is an alias or key is absent/outside validity in the signed trust snapshot.
cases.expected: Fail closed; canonical identity and trusted-key membership are mandatory.
